title: PromptMN：伪提示领域特定语言
summary: PromptMN 是一种伪提示领域特定语言，通过紧凑的 % 前缀类型化指令（角色、目标、约束等）注释自然语言，使提示更清晰、可检查、可复用。实验表明，前沿模型无需微调即可正确解析其指令，有望减少智能体因上下文歧义导致的失败。
summary_en: PromptMN is a pseudo-prompting DSL that annotates natural language with compact %-prefixed typed directives (roles, goals, constraints, etc.), making prompts more inspectable and reusable. Frontier models correctly resolve its instructions without fine-tuning, reducing agent failures from context ambiguity.
